assumptions_challenged: That MISEV2023 alone is sufficient to demonstrate whether SGL-001 has or has not produced program-specific CMC/analytics artifacts.

That the reviewer can conclude program-level absence of MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV release assays, stability/potency reproducibility, or bridging biodistribution studies based solely on the lack of those artifacts in the provided evidence set.

That rodent intranasal biodistribution data for SGL-001 are insufficient for cross-species translation without first confirming the program-specific orthogonal assays and comparability data (this is a reasonable precaution, but the claim of insufficiency for this specific program cannot be proven from a single guidance document).
falsification_conditions: Provide program-specific MCB and WCB master cell bank characterization and release records for SGL-001 (dossiers and test reports).
Submit fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV release assays applied to SGL-001, including method protocols, LLOQ, specificity, precision/accuracy and demonstrated range.
Provide stability study reports for SGL-001 showing stability-indicating attributes and lot-to-lot potency stability across relevant storage conditions.
Supply potency assay development and bridging data demonstrating correlation between the in vitro potency assay and an in vivo PD endpoint for SGL-001.
Provide representative GMP-like batch manufacturing records and release specifications (>=3 batches) with comparability reports showing reproducible release, stability, and potency.

Submit controlled large-animal intranasal biodistribution studies for SGL-001 that use orthogonal intact-EV analytics and include appropriate negative/positive and free-label controls to show measured signal maps to intact EVs rather than free label or contaminants.
strongest_objection: The reviewer’s conclusions rest on an asserted absence of SGL-001–specific CMC/analytics and in vivo bridging data, but the evidence set contains only the MISEV2023 consensus guideline. Thus the strongest objection is that the report treats absence-of-evidence in the supplied record as definitive evidence of program-level absence rather than an information gap; the reviewer cannot substantiate negative program-specific claims from the single provided guideline document.
